thread:
Ellen Park: Heads-up - AWS Marketplace invoice for Aug shows duplicate charges for reseller CloudEdge on SKU aws.ml.gpu.xlarge. total duplication ~$18,900. invoice pdf: https://s3.redwood.internal/invoices/aws/2026-08/CE-AWS-0826.pdf
Rahul Singh: ack. did this start after the reserved-instance conversion change last week? cc @Dana Morris
Dana Morris: likely. we changed the marketplace aggregator mapping to map legacy RI SKU -> consolidated `aws.ri.converted` meter on 2026-08-10. if aggregator didn't dedupe original usage lines it would double-bill.
Ellen Park: rough exposure?
Dana Morris: system shows two sets of line-items for same charge_id in the marketplace export. sum looks like $18,912.
Rahul Singh: can you paste the offending export lines (redact ids)?
Dana Morris: snippet (redacted):
```
charge_id,sku,amount_usd,notes
chr_aa111,aws.ml.gpu.xlarge,9456,usage
chr_aa111,aws.ri.converted,9456,ri_conversion
```
Both lines have same original usage timestamp and partner_tag. our ingestion normalized both as separate charges.
Ellen Park: @finance-bot can you open a tracking ticket and place a provisional dispute hold?
finance-bot: Created ticket FIN-4805. Provisional dispute hold applied for $18,912. Auto-collection paused for CloudEdge until resolved.
Rahul Singh: billing-ops - can you stop auto-exports or aggregation cron that runs the dedupe step? we need to prevent further duplicates for Aug and Sep runs.
billing-ops: pausing aggregation pipeline for marketplace-aggregation job. will redeploy dedupe fix to staging. ETA ~3h.
aws-partner: thanks for flagging. On our side, aggregator sent both `usage` and `ri_conversion` lines. we expect marketplace partners to treat `ri_conversion` as metadata and not bill separately. We'll push a patch to export to mark `ri_conversion` as internal_adjustment=false.
Dana Morris: reconcile job ran after a quick patch - confirms 1,998 USD per duplicate line for 10 duplicates = 18,980 (rounding diffs). I'm attaching reconciliation CSV to FIN-4805.
Ellen Park: recommend provisional approval to net up to $19k while we confirm final partner ledger.
Rahul Singh: Approved provisional up to $19,000. please mark for P&L adjustment for August accruals. :+1:
Dana Morris: I'll run a dedupe script and re-import cleaned export. posting diffs to FIN-4805 when done.
finance-bot: Note: please update FIN-4805 with sign-off when partner confirms ledger.
aws-partner: uploaded corrected ledger and confirm aggregator now tags `ri_conversion` as non-billable. apologies for the noise.
billing-ops: applied corrected import and removed duplicates. final net impact: credit issued for $18,912 to CloudEdge. Credit memo attached to FIN-4805.
Ellen Park: thanks everyone. action item for product/experiments: any mapping or conversion flags that change SKU mapping must run a dedupe + canary on a subset of partners. tagging @product-experiments in FIN-4805.
Dana Morris: noted. I'll open a follow-up with steps and a small test harness.
Ellen Park: closing thread after FIN-4805 final audit. :white_check_mark:
